name: Toyota
tagline: Car city with a wild, wooded heart.
intro_en: Toyota is synonymous with the carmaker headquartered here, but the city stretches far into the Mikawa highlands. Its best-known escape is Korankei, a river gorge famous for its autumn foliage, on the edge of Asuke, an old merchant town of earthen-walled storehouses.
For anyone curious about manufacturing, the city also offers a look at the industry that shaped modern Aichi.
getting_there_en: Toyota-shi Station is on the Meitetsu Mikawa Line and connects with the Tsurumai subway line from central Nagoya. Korankei is reached by bus from the city.
